issues.hypotheses: Same translated unit disks with fixed a=1,K=2,V=pi. For every0<d<1, graph height norm=d<a and whole boundary lies in punctured B2. Item5 is not an assumption of Lemma4.6.

Later applications permit arbitrarily small heights, so this does not show failure of Proposition4.3's intended estimates.
Tube is a genuine diffeomorphism at every interior point; failure concerns uniformity toward excluded endpoint.

issues.status: False unnecessary all-p Sobolev assertion; sufficient strong-L2 weighted-limit repair proved.

source_location.claim: Theorem3.1 Step3 asserts a uniform(p,2)-Sobolev inequality and strong Lp convergence for every p>1 from uniform H1 bounds.

issues.hypotheses: Compact smooth hypersurface dimension m=n-1>=3; a localized smooth bump. Normalization can preserve mean0 and L2norm1 while retaining bounded H1 norm. This example addresses the Sobolev/compactness inference, not the impossible full contradictory Rayleigh sequence.
issues.suspect_step: An unrestricted finite exponent p is used where compact Sobolev embedding only supplies subcritical p.
issues.decisive_evidence: b_delta=delta^(-(m-2)/2)psi(x/delta) has L2 norm~delta, gradient L2 norm~1 and Lp norm~delta^(m/p-(m-2)/2). m=3,p=8 gives exponent-1/8. Subtract mean, add fixed normalized smooth mean-zero u and renormalize; L8 remains unbounded.
counterevidence_and_alternatives: No claim that these bumps satisfy source inequality(3.12); no counterexample to Theorem3.1.
A subcritical p slightly above2 suffices; stronger all-p assertion is unnecessary.
The h_i limit includes3epsilon_M/2; source(3.13) and(3.17) already retain it. The omission in(3.16) is not counted as a separate issue.

repair.statement: Use strong L2 convergence under C1,alpha metric convergence and uniformly bounded h_i->c=n-1+3epsilon_M/2 in L1; then integral h_i f_i²->c.
repair.proof: Bound integral h_i(f_i²-f²) by M||f_i-f||2(||f_i||2+||f||2); truncate f² for integral(h_i-c)f². Uniform volume-density convergence handles varying measures. Lower semicontinuity gives energy<=c<lambda1, preserving the contradiction.
repair.verified_scope: Complete weighted-limit argument conditional on the source's established metric convergence and spectral gap; standard Rellich compactness used.
